visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-width story slider: each slide is a wide rounded photo with a caption and a story link over a dark bottom gradient; dash pagination and prev/next arrows are generated below the slides. No autoplay.
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-bleed slider of rounded photos (5:8 mobile, 16:9 tablet, 21:9 desktop) with a dark bottom gradient. White 20px caption and 'Read ... story >' link at the bottom left. Below: dash pagination (2px lines, 4px for the current slide) on the left, arrow buttons on the right, aligned with the content column.

contentPattern.structure: One row per slide, two cells: Image | caption paragraph, link paragraph ('Read ... story').
contentPattern.description: Interactive slider; each row is one slide. The last link in the caption cell is the story link and the whole caption is its click target. Controls (dots, arrows) are generated by the block code, never authored.
contentPattern.blockContent: Two story slides (Maurice, Veronica): wide photo, one-sentence caption, 'Read ... story' link

usage.description: Story slider of photo + caption + link slides.

reuseGuidance: Use for a rotating set of patient or feature stories with one photo and one link each. One row per slide (image | caption + link). Do not author dots or arrows.
